decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a multi-model line that moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing visible commitment and fits the firm's announced design-led direction.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has had its own page for two years, sits at the core of barrier-free bathroom architecture, and represents sunk development and tooling the firm will want to justify.

Launched in 2024 after the pump-assisted line C was withdrawn, the pump-drain channel is the firm's renewed public bet on pump drainage, so management will attribute any weak early results to the start-up phase and persist.
